title: Phase transition at designated states
statement: Let $p_{m exit}$ be a setup state, and let $q_{m entry}$, $q_{m acc}$, and $q_{m rej}$ be states of the deterministic run machine. From the setup phase, the designated exit state transitions to the initial guessing state, while other states have no phase transition. The completed writer transitions to the initial skipping state; completion of the skip transitions to the initial rewind state; and completion of the rewind transitions to the run phase at $q_{m entry}$. In the run phase, $q_{m acc}$ transitions to the output phase with verdict true, and otherwise $q_{m rej}$ transitions there with verdict false; all other states, including every state in the output phase, have no phase transition.
hypotheses_covered: $p_{m exit}$ is a state of the setup machine
$q_{m entry}$, $q_{m acc}$, and $q_{m rej}$ are states of the run machine
The setup and run state types have decidable equality
